# SLU Game Visual Pass

Use for broad visual improvement requests.

## Audit
Review environment, actors, player/weapon, lighting, materials, VFX, transitions, HUD, menus, results, mobile UI, and readability at normal gameplay distance.

## Workflow
1. Rank the weakest visible layers by impact.
2. Group fixes into one coherent visual language rather than polishing isolated objects endlessly.
3. Keep gameplay collision/state separate from presentation geometry.
4. Improve visuals and gameplay simultaneously when requested; do not force a fake sequential pipeline.
5. Preserve strong existing identity and readable actor silhouettes.
6. Validate screenshots in real rooms and representative gameplay, including worst-case effects.
7. Check mobile/performance implications for expensive presentation choices.

## Rules
- One hero-quality object surrounded by placeholders is not a finished visual pass.
- Empty/negative space can be part of the art direction.
- Player-facing text must obey the UI copy budget.
- Prefer reusable materials, lighting rigs, procedural modules, and stable visual registries.

## Completion bar
The player-visible stack should feel more internally consistent and closer to release, not merely more detailed.
